# Omarchy's logo as an Organon legibility fixture.
#
# Source: organonart/omarchy `logo.txt` (MIT), read 2026-09-02. The source is ragged —
# row widths 20, 80, 81, 81, 81, 81, 81, 81, 80, 47 — so every row here is padded to the
# widest (81) with blanks; the `|` fences make the padding visible. Doc §3's census
# (337 `█`, 312 spaces, 32 `▀`, 32 `▄`) counts only the EXPLICIT spaces of the source;
# on the padded grid the blank count is 409 (312 explicit + 97 implicit). Lit cells: 401.
#
# Single colour, deliberately: it is the shape census the spec measured, and it is
# nearly symmetric — which is why `asymmetric.txt` exists beside it. The colour is
# Omarchy's Tokyo Night foreground, chosen only so the fixture is not pure white.
# Format: native/organon-render/src/legibility.rs, `Fixture::parse`.
grid v1
cols 81
rows 10
aspect 2
order top-down
default #c0caf5
